sections.notes: solver.cpp:85–127,133–214 provides farfield/slip/no-slip ghost states and conservative inviscid/viscous face residual; Rusanov is robust but dissipative. 4/5 residual, 3/4 Rusanov, 2.5/3 farfield/slip, 2.5/3 no-slip, with numerical convergence limited by case evidence.
